question: How can these powers appear in many forms while remaining non-different?
premises: The powers enter into various acts and functions.
They are associated with many names and modes of worship.
Even so, their manifold form appears within non-difference.
inference: Multiplicity of function, name, and worship does not contradict the underlying non-difference of these powers.
plain_english: Thus, because of their entry into various acts and functions and because of the many names and forms of worship, their manifold form appears even within non-difference.
